moodys.citation_text: Moody's assigns Aa2 to Adventist Health System/Sunbelt Obligated Group's (dba AdventHealth Obligated Group) (FL) Series 2019A&B bonds; outlook stable. (Aa2/stable carried into 2022 with no reported change.)

sp.citation_text: S&P 'AA' rating with stable outlook reaffirmed on AdventHealth Obligated Group; carried into the May 2023 new-issue affirmation.

fitch.citation_text: AdventHealth had its default rating affirmed by Fitch at AA on May 22, 2023, outlook stable; carried from prior year.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch rates AdventHealth series 2023A, B and C bonds 'AA'; affirms outstanding; Outlook stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Strong financial profile, competitive market position in Florida, geographic diversity
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: AdventHealth has an AA rating and stable outlook with Fitch; affirmed May 22 2023.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: S&P assigns 'AA' to 2023A-C hospital revenue bonds, affirms 'AA' on outstanding; outlook stable
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: AdventHealth, FL 2023A-C Hospital Revenue Bonds Rated 'AA'; Outlook Stable

moodys.citation_text: Moody's Aa2/stable maintained for AdventHealth obligated group through window.

sp.citation_text: AdventHealth Obligated Group, FL 2024A-C Bonds Rated 'AA' by S&P

fitch.citation_text: AdventHealth affirmed at 'AA' amid strong financial profile per Fitch; carried through 2024.

outcome_class_rationale: All three agencies affirmed Aa2/AA/AA with stable outlooks through the window. No rating or outlook changes. AdventHealth also became operating manager for ex-Centura Colorado hospitals Aug 2023, neutral-to-positive for credit.
_notes: Centura Health joint venture with CommonSpirit dissolved Aug 2023 with AdventHealth taking five Colorado hospitals; rating agencies treated transaction as neutral.
